context:
Goal: banchi keeps only guards for tools you actually use, with one home per guard.
Problem (rule): a past banchi session added a setup for OpenAI's Codex coding tool (banchi decision D135, "Codex reads the same rules"): a .codex folder of hooks, AGENTS.md and .agents links, and Codex halves of four guards. You never used it, and these copies drift from the Claude Code guards.
Based on (read): lane banchi-drop-codex-guards, read only, 22:26 CST: deleting all of it loses nothing Claude Code runs. One catch: the reset --merge/--keep check lives only in banchi's guard-shell.py, so it moves to the shared guard first and the delete waits for that.
Based on (read): the same mistakes are caught today by the claude-settings Claude Code guards.
Departs from: banchi main, which keeps a Codex setup — a deletes it and rewrites D135; d deletes only the Codex-only guard clauses.

lastAnswer.note: Asked: "ive never used banchi in codex and had no idea that existed". Rewritten 22:22 CST. The coordinator's delete lane banchi-drop-codex-guards is paused until you pick (22:24 CST).

options.gain: No guard or link for a tool you never run; nothing to drift.
options.how: After the reset --merge/--keep check moves to the shared guard, a banchi lane deletes .codex/hooks.json, the AGENTS.md and .agents links, the Codex-only guard clauses with their checks and tests, and rewrites D135.
options.label: Delete all of banchi's Codex setup
options.lose: If you try Codex later, it starts with no guards or rules link.

options.gain: Less to delete; Codex could still read the rules.
options.how: The same lane deletes the Codex-only guard clauses and their tests; the AGENTS.md and .agents links stay.
options.label: Delete only the Codex-only guards
options.lose: The links stay for a tool you do not use.

options.gain: Codex is guarded in every repo.
options.how: claude-settings ships Codex hooks that call the shared guards; banchi deletes its copies.
options.label: Port to claude-settings
options.lose: Builds and keeps up hooks for a tool you do not use.

ref: docs/plans/child-guard-promotion.md on PR #1119 (ea66d8e), owner question 1, banchi rows 1, 7, 8, 9
title: You never use banchi in Codex: delete banchi's Codex setup and its Codex-only guards?
why: Recommended: a. Nothing you run uses them, and the Claude Code guards already cover the same mistakes.
